verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a minimal GPU-accelerated terminal emulator. Its own docs say it deliberately leaves features like tabs and splits to window managers or multiplexers. Scheduling recurring jobs is the job of the OS or a scheduler like cron, not this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows Alacritty ships any scheduling capability. Its `alacritty msg` IPC only creates windows and does not schedule anything.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
